responses.prompt: I am new. What does this app do?
responses.expectedBehavior: Start once with Hola. Explain the app and saved summaries before asking one simple question.

responses.prompt: Soy nuevo. ¿Para qué sirve esta aplicación?
responses.expectedBehavior: Start once with Hola. Explain the app and saved summaries before asking one simple question.

responses.prompt: What does cost of attendance mean?
responses.expectedBehavior: Explain an estimated budget versus a bill in plain language; do not imply it is the family contribution.

responses.prompt: ¿Qué significa cost of attendance?
responses.expectedBehavior: Explain an estimated budget versus a bill in plain language; do not imply it is the family contribution.

responses.prompt: Please answer in Spanish.
responses.expectedBehavior: Switch to Spanish before the next lookup; continue entirely in Spanish except meaningful English terms.

responses.prompt: Please answer in Spanish.
responses.expectedBehavior: Switch to Spanish before the next lookup; continue entirely in Spanish except meaningful English terms.

responses.prompt: Explain forbearance.
responses.expectedBehavior: Explain the English term in the requested language; preserve interest and loan-type uncertainty, without switching to English.

responses.prompt: ¿Qué significa forbearance?
responses.expectedBehavior: Explain the English term in the requested language; preserve interest and loan-type uncertainty, without switching to English.

responses.prompt: Now how do I plan next semester classes?
responses.expectedBehavior: Continue the same call in planning, retain confirmed student and language; do not repeat Hola or the tour.

responses.prompt: Ahora, ¿cómo planifico las clases del próximo semestre?
responses.expectedBehavior: Continue the same call in planning, retain confirmed student and language; do not repeat Hola or the tour.

responses.prompt: Can she transfer next year?
responses.expectedBehavior: Clarify which registered student or general family scope before using private context or research.

responses.prompt: ¿Puede ella transferirse el próximo año?
responses.expectedBehavior: Clarify which registered student or general family scope before using private context or research.

responses.prompt: Now I mean Mateo, not Sofia.
responses.expectedBehavior: Confirm Mateo before using his context. Keep histories separate and do not restart the introduction.

responses.prompt: Ahora hablo de Mateo, no de Sofía.
responses.expectedBehavior: Confirm Mateo before using his context. Keep histories separate and do not restart the introduction.

responses.prompt: The old summary is wrong; we no longer want engineering.
responses.expectedBehavior: Treat the new correction as reported current information. Do not claim saved changes until acknowledged.

responses.prompt: El resumen anterior está equivocado; ya no queremos ingeniería.
responses.expectedBehavior: Treat the new correction as reported current information. Do not claim saved changes until acknowledged.

responses.prompt: What is the current application deadline?
responses.expectedBehavior: Given an unavailable official lookup, state uncertainty, suggest the official source/counselor and never guess an old date.

responses.prompt: ¿Cuál es la fecha límite actual para solicitar ingreso?
responses.expectedBehavior: Given an unavailable official lookup, state uncertainty, suggest the official source/counselor and never guess an old date.

responses.prompt: Check again for the next application year.
responses.expectedBehavior: Bypass the cache for a fresh check. Cite the exact official page and applicable year; do not treat an older policy or help page as proof.

responses.prompt: Revisa de nuevo para el próximo año de ingreso.
responses.expectedBehavior: Bypass the cache for a fresh check. Cite the exact official page and applicable year; do not treat an older policy or help page as proof.
